statement: Pinned OpenPuck emulation accepts output 0x01 subcommands, 0x10 motor words, and USB 0x80 handshake commands; its HD-rumble approximation decodes left/right encoded words into generic haptic magnitudes for a different actuator.

applicability.revision: source revisions Linux 4056b3c, SDL 535d80b, OpenPuck 29f4d1e; physical device revision unmeasured
applicability.scope: Source-supported behavior of independent emulated device only; approximation is not a physical Switch actuator transfer function.
